top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Wash Infant's Hands (26 TAC §746.3505(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A childs hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Diapering Procedures - Caregiver's Hands Washed (26 TAC §746.3505(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregivers hands were observed to not be washed after a childs diaper was changed.

top_violation_types.title: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The deficiencies in the Fire Marshal inspection report from 9/24/2024 have not been corrected.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.
